llm_response.reason: The site displays several hallmarks of scam online stores: no clear legal company identification, no physical address, no business-appropriate contact information, and an unclear privacy/returns policy. It mimics the products and brand (Aubade) of legitimate sites without proof of authorization, and uses urgency/discount tactics. External searches and registrant data are non-existent or unavailable, increasing the risk profile. These factors match multiple outlined scam indicators—particularly characteristics 4, 5, 6, 7, and 16.
